resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says the steel tower was eventually moved to North Stonington; Forest Lookouts marks it Removed. Status set to relocated, with the destination unconfirmed. The 1951 item describes a new tower on Stewart Hill, in North Stonington, but does not say the old tower went there.

notes_for_editor: Spelling differs: the 1932 item says Chasanba lodge, the AHGP guide says Chashamba Lodge; each is quoted as printed. The 1932 and 1938 items are read through Forest Lookouts transcriptions of The Day; the newspapers themselves were not read. The move to North Stonington rests on the register alone; the Stewart Hill link is open and a person could check North Stonington or Stewart Hill records. No build date, builder or removal date was found. The Wikipedia page for Fort Hill (Groton) returned 404. The AHGP guide mentions the tower may be climbed; not used, and the site is gone.
